answer: A mask costs nothing until Die engraver gem stone mark engraved into the print room sets its price, and the price is written as each gem stone is a plate record witnessed by the inspector. No mask rides free: each one is charged 103 POA and 24 minutes, and 741 of them come to 76323 POA and 17784 minutes. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Without a kernel the brick has no maker, without a pulse it has no weight, and without a quartz it has no firing — and a farm's brick is missing all three at once.
